invariants: The string scanner begins at a valid quote and captures escape mode before blanking. It advances past each segment and carries mode only across a PostgreSQL continuation gap.
Continuation lookahead is read-only. It admits ASCII horizontal spaces, CR/LF and line comments, requires a newline, and rejects block comments and operators.
Only accepted continuation gaps are blanked together with their literals, preventing comment or string version words from leaking into the write check.
A per-acquisition Locked[bool] serializes the one-time token removal; later calls cannot remove another acquisition's token.
Both Apply and its five-second watchdog are children of the same bounded group. The first child closes its completion channel, and the watchdog's timer and flag have explicit ownership.
The existing migration prefix behavior and tests remain; the specification states the missing resume guarantee.
